title: CAPEX single-sheet runtime draft (post-feedback revision)
previous_revision_summary: Previous version used simplified C.01..C.05 grouping. User feedback: C.01..C.05 was a screenshot crop, not the full model. CAPEX must preserve C.01..C.18 hierarchy and sub-lines.
base_sha_start_note: post-57A-2, CAPEX single-sheet direction characterization merged
what_this_pr_does: Promotes the app to source of truth for CAPEX. Renders the canonical C.01..C.18 hierarchy with sub-lines (C.01.01, C.01.02, ...) in a single Excel-like CAPEX input sheet (sheet_capex.html). Removes the Excel-vs-App reconciliation Detail view from the primary CAPEX tab. Documents future model inputs (VAT, WHT, depreciation, payment schedule, utilisation) and a Sources & Uses bridge.

data_source.fallback: C.01..C.18 scaffold rendered from project_ctx.capex_items (6-section summary mapped to C.01..C.05 + C.17 financing rows)

sub_line_sanitization: Dotted codes (C.01.01) are sanitized to underscores (C_01_01) for use in HTML input name attributes. The full dotted code is preserved in data-capex-code-full.
